'''Ojom''' was a frozen ocean [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]]. Largely inhospitable, several [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] hung in orbit so as to accommodate other species less acclimated to the cold.

==Description==
[[File:Besalisk-NEGAS.png|thumb|left|180px|A Besalisk, native to Ojom]]
A frozen [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] world in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], Ojom was the homeworld of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]], a four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] species. Because of the oceanic nature of the planet, Besalisks survived by creating a commune upon the many glaciers adrift on the world's oceans. Despite the several separate communities, the planet was sparsely populated. Many [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] orbited the world, and the populations on these stations actually exceeded that of those communities planetside. The stations filled the role of [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] for the planet, and accommodations were much more hospitable than those on Ojom.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
Discovered by the [[galactic community]] following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Ojom had no standing government outside of the communal arbiters which governed each community. As such, Ojom could not petition for representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], something which the Besalisks had no interest in doing in any case.<ref name="TEA" /> Content to let galactic affairs continue without their involvement, Ojom avoided [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation by means of the Besalisks' underworld contacts with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], though these bargains ended with Ojom becoming woefully indebted. Indeed, many Besalisks ended up enslaved to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] as they struggled to pay the terrible price of their planet remaining free of the Empire's control. To this end, the planet became infested with criminal elements during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], typically due to offworlders committing crimes against each other.<ref name="NEGAS" />

After his [[Battle of Centares (Galactic Civil War)|defeat]] during the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns]] around 8 ABY, [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] fled in the Deep Core where he created his [[Greater Maldrood|small empire]]. Ojom was one of the planets controlled by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. Like the other Deep Core systems, the [[Ojom system/Legends|Ojom system]] was abandoned by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] after the [[Imperial Reunification]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
